title: Chain Reversal
description: Reverse the direction of every link in a singly linked chain and print the resulting node values from the new head to the tail.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n node values in chain order.
outputFormat: Print the reversed node values separated by spaces.
hints: Keep track of the previous node while redirecting the current node's next pointer.

examples.explanation: The chain order is completely reversed.
The last node becomes the new head.
